about_the_game:
Embark on an intergalactic journey in Stellar Destiny: The Last Survivor, a fast-paced, action-packed sci-fi adventure where survival hinges on your ability to slay monstrous foes, craft powerful gear, and explore uncharted planets. Step into the role of a sentient AI ship, the last of its kind, as it traverses the cosmos, gathering chemical elements and unraveling the mysteries of the universe.

Why Stellar Destiny Will Hook You

  • You raid alien worlds and strip them of their rare resources.

  • Asymmetric action – Combine your SYNr’s fast-paced attacks with the tactical support of your drone.

  • Smart crafting – Use harvested elements to create powerful compounds that can launch you to greatness… or backfire if poorly combined.

  • Killer builds – Mix active and passive abilities into deadly synergies.

  • Combat that slaps – Dodge, strike, dash — every fight demands your focus.

  • Tense mining moments – While the drone extracts resources, combat support shuts down. Can you hold the line alone?

  • Every planet is different – Discover new biomes, materials, and tough new challenges.

  • Talents & story – Unlock new traits and uncover the mystery behind who you are — and why everyone wants you dead.

  • Be a build master – Experiment with combinations and push the system to its limits. A good build saves you, a bad one breaks you.

  • Replayable chaos – Procedurally generated worlds, ever-changing loadouts, and evolving playstyles.

Explore planets

Explore planets and mine rare elements on each planet. However, be aware that each planet has its unique flora and fauna, which will not be friendly and will defend itself against invasive AI. Each planet has its specific theme and will challenge you differently.

Slay enemies

Slay enemies with unique weapons and combinations of skills. You will be using your trusty sword and drone, which have unique skills to help you in combat. Is laser your preferred weapon in combination with a flaming sword? Or would you rather slay enemies in a whirlwind of acid while your drone spits out rockets? The choice is yours.

Craft your gear

You will need upgrades and good gear to survive in a hostile environment. You will be able to do so with elements you will mine on each planet! Craft unique compounds that will boost specific stats and create unique combos so your AI can have a time of its li... computing power, while slaying thousands of native animals.

Dominate!

Are you ready to dominate the galaxy and build up the AI to fearlessly wander through the galaxy? The time is now!

🔥 READY TO TEST THE DEMO?

This is your call to action: Play the DEMO now, Test out brutal close combat, feel the atmosphere, and discover everything Stellar Destiny has to offer. Your feedback pushes us forward — and who knows, maybe you’ll help shape the system itself.

🎮 Download the Demo
⚔️ Unleash your SYNr in combat
💬 Join our Discord and tell us what you love
🌟 Wishlist the game so you don’t miss the next update!

JOIN OUR DISCORD

Do you have an idea for an improvement, a bug to report, or just want to chat about your Stellar Destiny? Join our Discord!

You'll find the development team, the community, and the latest news there. So what are you waiting for?

content_descriptors.notes: The game includes a depiction of aliens and their killing.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: 4 Cores / 2.5 GHz+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 970 / AMD RX 570 (Adrenalin 22.1.2)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: 6-8 Cores / 3.5 GHz+
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1070 / AMD RX 570 (Adrenalin 22.1.2)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: This is exactly what you came for. Experience high-octane sci-fi adventure! Slay fierce monsters, explore alien worlds, craft deadly compounds, and upgrade your AI body to survive. Master high-speed melee and drone warfare to uncover the secrets of a galaxy on the edge of collapse!
